Story.Title: Midnight Signal / La Señal de Medianoche
Story.Logline: Across a rain-slicked Nairobi midnight, D.Leston tracks an encrypted analog frequency to a glass transit atrium where acoustic archivist Zuri Vance hands him the master amber reel needed to broadcast a live human signal before dawn.

Character.Name: D_Leston
Character.Rol/Description: Signal Architect & Acoustic Technologist — tracks the analog frequency across the city
Character.Appearance: dleston man, Hispanic/Mediterranean man in his late 30s, loose dark wavy hair with silver strands and faded sides, salt-and-pepper beard, intense focused eyes
Character.Wardrobe: Charcoal wool trench coat over a matte black turtleneck, matte-black studio headphones resting around his neck

Character.Name: Zuri Vance
Character.Rol/Description: Underground Acoustic Archivist — keeper of the analog master reels
Character.Appearance: East African woman in her early 30s, sculpted high braided updo woven with subtle copper thread, high cheekbones, calm piercing dark eyes
Character.Wardrobe: Tailored ochre-gold leather field jacket over an ivory silk shirt, dark tailored trousers
Character.Personality: Poised, enigmatic, fiercely protective of the analog archive

Props.Name: Vintage Brass Field Transceiver
Props.Description: Handheld brushed-brass analog radio transceiver with two glowing warm amber vacuum tubes and an analog needle dial

Props.Name: Copper-Bound Frequency Ledger
Props.Description: Weathered leather-and-copper notebook filled with hand-drawn acoustic waveform charts

Props.Name: Luminous Amber Magnetic Tape Reel
Props.Description: Precision-machined translucent amber 10-inchオープン magnetic audio reel etched with gold timecode markings

Scenes.Scene_Name: Scene 1: The Rain-Slicked Overpass (El Paso Elevado)
Scenes.Scene_plot: At midnight on a rain-slicked elevated walkway overlooking Nairobi's neon-and-sodium skyline, D.Leston tunes his brass transceiver until the amber vacuum tubes lock onto the hidden frequency.
Scenes.Scene_background: Rain-slicked concrete pedestrian overpass at midnight, wet asphalt reflecting cyan and warm sodium-vapor streetlamps, mist rising in the background.

dop_direction.lighting_setup: High-contrast wet reflections: cool cyan nocturnal rain backlight balanced against warm 2700K amber glow from the transceiver vacuum tubes on D.Leston's face
dop_direction.color_override: Deep midnight slate, wet cyan reflections, warm amber tube glow

Character_states.wardrobe: Charcoal wool trench coat over a matte black turtleneck, matte-black studio headphones resting around his neck

beats.blocking_action: D.Leston stands under a flickering streetlamp on the rain-slicked overpass, holding the Vintage Brass Field Transceiver as rain beads on his charcoal trench coat.
beats.spoken_text: En medio del ruido sintético, todavía existe una frecuencia que no se puede falsificar.

beats.blocking_action: Tight close-up as D.Leston rotates the brass dial; the twin amber vacuum tubes flare brightly, reflecting in his pupils as he raises the transceiver.
beats.spoken_text: Ahí está. Pulso analógico puro a trescientos metros.

beats.blocking_action: D.Leston looks up toward the illuminated glass transit atrium across the wet plaza and strides forward through the mist.

Scenes.Scene_Name: Scene 2: The Glass Transit Atrium (El Encuentro)
Scenes.Scene_plot: Inside the misted glass transit atrium, Zuri Vance waits with her copper-bound frequency ledger. D.Leston arrives (persisting his Scene 1 trench coat and brass transceiver) and receives the luminous amber master reel.
Scenes.Scene_background: Architectural glass-and-steel transit atrium at night, condensation on tall glass panels, warm tungsten overhead practicals contrasting with blue rain outside.

dop_direction.lighting_setup: Warm 3200K tungsten overhead architectural lighting inside the glass atrium with rain streaks on the glass walls
dop_direction.color_override: Ochre gold, warm tungsten amber, and deep slate glass

Character_states.wardrobe: Tailored ochre-gold leather field jacket over an ivory silk shirt, dark tailored trousers

beats.blocking_action: Zuri Vance stands beside a rain-streaked glass pillar in her ochre-gold leather jacket, holding the copper-bound frequency ledger against her chest as she watches the entrance.
beats.spoken_text: You followed the carrier wave all the way through the storm.

beats.blocking_action: D.Leston steps inside the glass atrium—still wearing his rain-dampened charcoal trench coat, turtleneck, headphones, and holding the brass transceiver—and nods to Zuri.
beats.spoken_text: La señal me trajo hasta aquí. ¿Tienes la bobina maestra?

beats.blocking_action: Zuri Vance opens the copper ledger and lifts the Luminous Amber Magnetic Tape Reel into the warm tungsten light, extending it toward D.Leston.
beats.spoken_text: Guard it well. Once this reel spins at dawn, every ear in the city will wake.

Scenes.Scene_Name: Scene 3: The Rooftop Acoustic Dome (La Transmisión)
Scenes.Scene_plot: Inside a rooftop geodesic acoustic studio as pre-dawn gold breaks over Nairobi, D.Leston (having shed his trench coat into a rolled-sleeve black shirt and aviator sunglasses, holding the amber reel) mounts the tape while Zuri Vance watches in her persisted ochre-gold jacket.
Scenes.Scene_background: Rooftop geodesic glass-and-timber acoustic broadcast dome overlooking the Nairobi skyline at pre-dawn blue-and-gold hour, vintage reel-to-reel master console in center.

dop_direction.lighting_setup: First rays of golden-hour sunrise slicing through the geodesic dome glass, meeting the warm amber glow of the master tape console
dop_direction.color_override: Pre-dawn indigo transitioning into radiant solar gold and warm mahogany

Character_states.wardrobe: Matte black rolled-sleeve button-down shirt, matte-black studio headphones over his ears, gold-rimmed aviator sunglasses resting on his collar

beats.blocking_action: In his rolled-sleeve black button-down shirt with studio headphones over his ears, D.Leston locks the Luminous Amber Magnetic Tape Reel onto the rooftop master console and engages the broadcast lever.
beats.spoken_text: La bobina está en posición. Ahora la ciudad escucha nuestra voz real.

beats.blocking_action: Zuri Vance—still in her ochre-gold leather jacket holding the copper ledger—smiles quietly beside the spinning amber reel as golden sunrise floods the geodesic dome.
beats.spoken_text: Signal locked. Welcome to the new chapter.
